title: Ashes on the Wharf
short_summary: A hardboiled detective confronts a haunted accomplice on the docks, unraveling the truth behind a mob killing and a lost friendship.
world_context: A rain-soaked, mid-20th-century American city, where the docks are ruled by shadows and the mob's influence runs deep. The story unfolds at night, under the harsh glow of sodium lamps and the ever-present threat of violence.

characters.name: Jack Malone
characters.physical_traits: Tall, lean, weathered face with a five o'clock shadow, piercing blue eyes, short dark hair, often seen with a cigarette.
quirks: Always flicks his lighter twice before lighting a cigarette
Keeps his hands in his coat pockets
characters.typical_attire: Dark trench coat, fedora, rumpled dress shirt, slacks, scuffed leather shoes.
characters.backstory: Jack grew up in the city’s working-class neighborhoods, learning early how to survive on the streets. He became a detective after his brother was killed in a mob crossfire, vowing to bring justice to those the law overlooks.
characters.motivations: Driven by guilt and a sense of justice, Jack is relentless in his pursuit of the truth, even when it means confronting old friends or risking his own life.

characters.name: Tommy Russo
characters.physical_traits: Short, wiry build, gaunt face with hollow cheeks, dark circles under his eyes, nervous hands, slicked-back black hair.
characters.typical_attire: Threadbare jacket, faded shirt, worn trousers, battered cap.
characters.backstory: Tommy grew up alongside Jack and Eddie, but drifted into the mob’s orbit for survival. Haunted by his choices, he’s caught between loyalty, fear, and regret.
characters.motivations: Desperate to survive, Tommy is torn by guilt over Eddie’s death and the threat of the mob. He seeks forgiveness but believes he’s beyond redemption.

characters.name: Eddie Santoro
characters.physical_traits: Broad-shouldered, kind eyes, dark curly hair, warm smile (seen only in flashbacks or referenced objects).
quirks: Always looked out for his sister
characters.backstory: Eddie was a childhood friend to both Jack and Tommy. He tried to stay clean but was drawn into the mob’s world to protect his family.
characters.motivations: Protect his sister and friends, even at the cost of his own life.

chapters.chapter_summary: Jack corners Tommy on the silent docks at night, pressing him for the truth about Eddie’s murder. Tommy, haunted and desperate, confesses his role and the mob’s threat. Their confrontation is laced with regret, guilt, and the weight of lost friendship.

scenes.scene_description: Jack arrives at the deserted docks, the wind and distant ship’s horn setting a somber mood.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Establishing shot of the deserted city docks at night. The wharf stretches into darkness, lit by scattered sodium lamps. Water glistens black between rusted steel pilings. Wind stirs loose papers and debris. In the distance, a cargo ship’s silhouette looms, its horn echoing across the water. The atmosphere is cold and foreboding. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Setting the scene: silent, empty docks under harsh lighting.

dialogue.text: The docks were silent but for the wind and a distant ship’s horn.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues and grays with harsh yellow highlights

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Wide shot of Jack Malone standing at the edge of the wharf, his silhouette framed against the shimmering water. His trench coat flaps in the wind, hands deep in pockets, fedora pulled low. The city skyline glows faintly in the background. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack surveys the empty docks, searching for Tommy.
panels.color_palette: muted navy, slate gray, pale yellow

important_objects.label: man in trench coat and fedora

pages.page_description: Establishes the lonely, windswept docks and Jack’s arrival.

scenes.scene_description: Jack corners Tommy on the wharf, tension rising as Tommy’s hand hovers near his knife.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Jack stepping out from behind a stack of crates, blocking Tommy’s path. Jack’s posture is tense, his eyes fixed on Tommy. The wharf is slick with rain, shadows stretching behind them. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack confronts Tommy, cutting off his escape.

dialogue.text: Jack cornered Tommy on the wharf.

important_objects.label: man in trench coat and fedora

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Tommy Russo, gaunt and exhausted, his hand hovering near the handle of a pocketknife in his jacket. His eyes are shadowed, face drawn. The wind tugs at his battered cap. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Tommy hesitates, hand near his knife, uncertain.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Tommy’s face, eyes hollow and haunted, lips pursed as he whistles a broken aria. His breath fogs in the cold air. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Tommy whistles an aria, voice faltering.

pages.page_description: Jack blocks Tommy’s escape; Tommy’s anxiety and exhaustion are clear.

scenes.scene_description: Jack accuses Tommy, pressing him about Eddie’s murder and the mob’s involvement.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Jack, facing Tommy. Jack’s shoulders are squared, fists clenched at his sides. Tommy stands in the harsh glow of a dock lamp, his face tense. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack confronts Tommy with the accusation.

dialogue.text: You killed him. The gloves, the debt—‘forgiven’ in the mob’s ledger the night Eddie died.

panels.color_palette: harsh yellow, deep blue, shadowed gray

important_objects.label: man in trench coat and fedora

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Tommy’s trembling hand, fingers hovering over the handle of his pocketknife inside his jacket. The knuckles are white, veins visible. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Tommy’s hand shakes, torn between fight and surrender.

pages.page_description: Jack’s accusation lands; Tommy’s fear and guilt are visible.

scenes.scene_description: Tommy confesses, voice shaking, revealing the mob’s threat and Eddie’s plea for his sister.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Tommy, shoulders slumped, eyes glistening with tears. He looks away from Jack, voice barely above a whisper. The dock lamp casts a long shadow behind him. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Tommy confesses, unable to meet Jack’s gaze.

dialogue.text: The boss said do it, or I’d be next. Eddie—he begged for his sister. I tried to warn him.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack’s face, jaw clenched, eyes narrowed with anger and pain. Raindrops streak his cheek. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack struggles to contain his anger and sorrow.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Tommy, tears on his cheeks, holding a worn baseball card in trembling fingers. The card is faded, edges frayed. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Tommy reveals the baseball card, symbol of lost friendship.

dialogue.text: We played ball as kids. I thought—maybe he’d forgive me.

pages.page_description: Tommy’s confession and the baseball card reveal the depth of his guilt.

scenes.scene_description: Jack delivers his verdict; Tommy collapses under the weight of guilt as the city presses down.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Jack, arms folded, looking down at Tommy with a mix of pity and resolve. The dock lights cast long shadows between them. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack delivers his final words to Tommy.

dialogue.text: You’re out of second chances, Tommy.

important_objects.label: man in trench coat and fedora

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Tommy’s face, eyes downcast, tears streaking his cheeks. His features sag, defeated. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Tommy collapses emotionally, broken by guilt.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Wide shot from above: Jack and Tommy stand apart on the empty wharf, both dwarfed by the vast, dark city behind them. The city lights flicker in the mist, and the water laps quietly at the pilings. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Both men stand in silence, the city’s weight pressing down.

dialogue.text: The city’s weight pressed both men down.

panels.color_palette: deep blue, slate gray, faint gold

pages.page_description: Jack’s verdict and Tommy’s collapse; the city looms over their fate.
